name: 系统边界与拓扑隔离

question.instructions: Evaluate compliance with System Boundaries: strict unidirectional module dependencies, core libraries/thin boundaries kept free from upper-layer heavy runtime/framework intrusion, and self-contained domain responsibilities.

criteria.passed: Clean dependency hierarchy. Lower-layer core/utility/thin modules have zero reverse dependencies on upper-layer services or heavy host frameworks, and modules follow strict unidirectional flow.
criteria.violated: Violates boundary: heavy upper-layer frameworks/containers leaking into lower-layer core/thin modules, cross-boundary leakage, or circular module dependencies.

why: 核心正交架构红线：模块间保持严格单向依赖，底层核心库或轻量化边界组件严禁被上层重型框架反向侵入，职责边界保持自闭环。
